therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Selective binding to mannose receptors on macrophages in lymph nodes
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Lymphatic mapping and sentinel lymph node identification
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with breast cancer or melanoma requiring sentinel lymph node biopsy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Concordance of Blue Dye and Lymphoseek detection

results.target_engagement_evidence: High concordance with blue dye standard demonstrates lymph node targeting
safety_signals: 5 serious adverse events in 179 patients including myocardial infarction, nausea, vomiting, cellulitis, and modified radical mastectomy

dose_info.dose: 0.2-0.4 mL (breast cancer intradermal/periareolar/subareolar), 2.0-4.0 mL (breast cancer peritumor), 0.2-0.4 mL (melanoma intradermal)
dose_info.schedule: single injection or multiple divided injections at surgery

context.indication: Breast cancer and melanoma requiring sentinel lymph node biopsy
